svg.text: Nokta Academy — MongoDB/Mongoose Entity Relationship Diagram
Reference map from application schemas • Blue: ObjectId reference • ? optional/null • [] array reference • UQ unique constraint
Every collection has _id:ObjectId. Base-schema collections also include createdAt, updatedAt, isDeleted and deletedBy?→User; common fields are not repeated.
A scalar ref means 0..1 or 1 parent per child (required fields omit ?); the inverse cardinality is 0..N unless unique. A [] ref represents application-managed M:N.
MongoDB does not enforce foreign keys or cascades. These are Mongoose references only; deletion and referential integrity must be enforced by application services.
Important model distinctions: Result.student, AIResultInsight.studentId, StudentMessage.studentId, and StationerySale.studentId reference User; ExamResult and most academic records reference Student.
